verdict.rationale: Cognee ships an official, documented Python API: `remember`, `recall`, `improve` and `forget` are single-call operations, including session-scoped usage like `cognee.remember(data, session_id=...)` and `cognee.start_ui()`. A Dockerized REST API is also documented for building against it. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages other than Python, a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
